title: Caption Track
description: Word/phrase-level timing for one scene's narration, produced by scripts/generate_captions.py (faster-whisper) and consumed by remotion_template's StudioComposition.tsx via @remotion/captions. The `captions` array items are shaped identically to @remotion/captions' own Caption type (verified against remotion-dev/remotion's packages/captions/src/caption.ts) so the JSON can be fed to createTikTokStyleCaptions()/renderers without transformation. Also doubles as CLAUDE.md section 10's faster-whisper listen-check evidence for long-compound-number findings (checklist_common.long_compound_number_findings) - same transcription, two consumers.

source_audio.description: Path to the narration file that was transcribed, relative to the project root.

model.description: faster-whisper model name (e.g. "base", "small") - part of the deterministic-replay record (CLAUDE.md law #5).

language.description: BCP-47-ish language code faster-whisper detected or was told to use (e.g. "tr").

inputs_fingerprint.description: sha256 over the inputs that determine this transcription (audio file sha256 + model + language) - CLAUDE.md hard rule: every write records sha256 + inputs_fingerprint. Re-running with an unchanged audio file/model/language is a no-op (matches ArtifactCache's fingerprint() convention in lib/production_ledger.py).

captions.description: Same shape as @remotion/captions' Caption[] - text, startMs, endMs, timestampMs, confidence. text is whitespace-sensitive per Remotion's own convention (include the leading space before each word except the first).
